synopsis: Keitaro is ready to stop living as a shut-in. He’s starting university. He’s reconnecting with his childhood friend. He’s taking a tutoring job. (Source: VIZ Media) Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

synopsis: When the chant "Eko Eko Azarak" sounds something is bound to occur, be it within the town or the school! A classic horror manga, Eko Eko Azarak follows the witch Misa Kuroi ("Black Mass" in Japanese), and the various horrors she encounters during her travels. While relatively unknown outside of Japan the series was extremely well received domestically. title: Code Geass: Shinketsu no Almaria
titleNative: コードギアス新潔のアルマリア
synopsis: Year 4, Kouwa era. After "The Day of Miracles," large-scale conflicts between nations ceased, and the world enjoyed a period of peace. However, conflict was not entirely eradicated. Seeds of conflict inevitably sprouted, sown by those who could not survive without conflict, those who sought wealth through conflict, and those who simply desired conflict. An organization existed to nip these seeds of conflict in the bud and prevent conflicts from escalating. Its name is "Izayoi," a secret agency established by Sumeragi Kaguya, who once served as chairman of the United Federation of Nations. Hakuba Sōga, a member of Izayoi, as Agent Shinigetsu, along with his assistant Satori, is tasked with pursuing the mysterious black Nightmare Frame, Pure Elements G.

But in the year 2030, Earth, once humanity's cradle, is on the verge of human extinction. Survivors: 258. Gundam: One. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis: Noble young lady Nicole has had her heart broken more times than she can count. Her fiancé Keios is so devoted to Princess Caroline, his childhood friend and the unrivalled belle of their aristocratic academy, that he seems to forget Nicole even exists. But no longer. Tired of waiting around and conforming to Keios’ needs, Nicole makes a most liberating decision: I’ll give up on love and go it alone. Her arranged marriage may be unavoidable, but that doesn’t mean she can’t enjoy her own life, right? Emboldened and excited, Nicole begins to shine as she never had before—so brightly, in fact, that even the clueless Keios can’t help but notice… (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Seinaru Kishi no Ankokudou
titleNative: 聖なる騎士の暗黒道
synopsis: Young Sain Forth has it made; as the famed Holy Knight, he has the people’s love, the respect of kings, and the blessings of a literal goddess. His aspirations lie elsewhere, though. With his assistant Melia at his side, he leaves for an academy in a foreign kingdom, where he is treated as a deviant by his peers. It’s his own fault, mind you—his stubborn insistance on wearing a custom, all-black uniform makes him stick out. He isn’t the only outcast in his class: Alicia, born into the Clan of Light but unable to use anything but fire magic, faces similar struggles, and the two quickly become allies. Alicia proposes that they enter the labyrinth below the school in search of a holy sword, but Sain has other plans in mind: a doom sword. And so, with his friends in tow, Sain ventures into the perilous unknown, driven by a wish to become the coolest, edgiest, most awesome thing in existence: a Dark Knight. There’s just one problem. He can’t use dark magic. Like, at all. (Source: J-Novel Club)

synopsis: A certain girl genius with more power than knowledge accidentally summoned dozens of students and teachers into a dangerous world filled with beasts and magic, but the protagonist isn’t a student or the homeroom teacher… it’s the janitor. At the time of their summoning, the students and teachers each gained a power formed from their soul, but not the janitor. As the janitor was about to be bestowed with a power that would protect him, his power was forcibly taken from him by an arrogant student. Having gone three years without a contract extension, he failed to get a job after having graduated from a third-rate university. Somehow he is still a contractor at 25 years old and was a janitor for 2 years, with a take-home monthly salary of less than ¥120,000. synopsis: Leafe, the eldest daughter of a duke, is the reincarnation of the dark magician Laurie. In her previous life, she was feared as an evil woman of unparalleled wickedness and lived a solitary life. In this life, she has avoided loneliness and has successfully lived a smooth life surrounded by her family and fiancé. However, her younger sister Aria stole her fiancé and kicked her out of the house, returning her to a life of solitude. In order to attend Aria's engagement party and fight back, Leafe asks Oliver, the crown prince of a neighboring country, to be her partner. She thought this would be a one-off, but for some reason Oliver has asked her to marry him!? (Source: Kodansha, translated)

titleNative: シャドーハウス
synopsis: In the depths of a murky mansion lives a group of enigmatic nobles known as...the Shadow family. But in a house of locked doors, living according to rules from no apparent source—how long can their blissfully peaceful existence truly last...? (Source: Yen Press)
